care.summary: Tropical climbing vegetable with bitter fruit; thrives in hot, humid subtropical gardens with a trellis.
care.water: Keep evenly moist in heat; mulch to reduce stress
care.fertilizer: Balanced NPK every 2 weeks while vines run
care.toxicity: Fruit edible when cooked; raw fruit is intensely bitter
common_issues: Poor fruit set if nights are cool
tips: Harvest young fruit for milder bitterness
care.climate_notes: Best in USDA-like tropical/subtropical zones; protect from cold snaps below 15°C.
